meta.name: agenttrace-session-audit
meta.description: Audit local AI coding-agent sessions with agenttrace for cost, tokens, tool failures, latency, anomalies, health, diffs, and CI gates.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计本地 AI 编程会话,掌握成本与运行故障
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常用 AI 编程助手并想看清它的开销与问题
copy.tagline_en: Audit your AI coding session history for cost and anomalies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you rely on AI coding assistants and want to understand their cost and reliability

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 agenttrace 工具审计本地 AI 编码代理的会话记录，检查成本、token、工具失败、延迟、异常、健康分数和 CI 门槛，并生成 Markdown 或 JSON 报告。若无会话则运行诊断并说明。
howto.when: 当用户要求审计本地 AI 代理的会话记录，查看成本、token、健康等指标，或检查 CI 门禁准备情况时触发。

say.text: 审计最近的会话，给我一份 Markdown 报告。
say.note: 运行 agenttrace --latest 并生成报告。

say.text: 用 JSON 格式分析当前目录的会话日志。
检查健康分数，是否适合加 CI 门禁？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses the agenttrace tool to audit local AI coding-agent session logs, checking cost, tokens, tool failures, latency, anomalies, health scores, and CI gates, then produces Markdown or JSON reports. If no sessions are found, it runs diagnostics and explains.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to audit local agent session logs, review cost, token, health metrics, or check CI gate readiness.

say_en.text: Audit the latest session and give me a Markdown report.
say_en.note: Runs agenttrace --latest and generates a report.

say_en.text: Analyze session logs in the current directory as JSON.
Check health scores; is it suitable for a CI gate?
